source.name: Valencia CF: Divina Seguros renews its partnership with Valencia CF as Official Insurer for the next two seasons
source.quote: Divina Seguros will maintain its presence on the sleeve of the official match and training shirts of the men's first team and the VCF Academy. Through this renewed agreement until 2027
source.note: The deal began in 2023-24: Divina Seguros' Memoria Anual 2024 (divinaseguros.com/doc/eH4) says it is sleeve partner 'para las temporadas 2023-2024 y 2024-2025'.
